title: Netanyahu rival condemns ‘Jewish terrorism’ after settler attacks on Palestinian villages
summary_full: Dozens of militant Israeli settlers raided communities on Saturday night, setting fire to vehicles and several homes  Arson attacks by militant Israeli settlers on Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank have caused a political row in Israel, drawing condemnation from Gadi Eisenkot, the opposition leader, who described them as “Jewish terrorism”.Dozens of settlers raided Palestinian communities overnight on Saturday, setting fire to about a dozen vehicles and several homes and scrawling racist graffiti. At least four communities were attacked. Israeli police said they had launched an investigation with forensic teams. Continue reading...
